title: docs: rename BYOP guide to Connect User Wallets
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Renames the guide and drawer item to Connect User Wallets
- Updates repository-owned `#tag/byop` links
- Preserves old fragment and guide URLs
- Uses BYOP only as alternate terminology
- Leaves `APIDOCS.md` untouched

Tests: gen docs routes, 7/7 passed.

gist.headline: Wallets, plainly labeled
gist.blurb: BYOP has grown a more self-explanatory name: Connect User Wallets. The old paths still lead home, because URLs deserve a long and quiet life.
gist.summary: Renamed the Bring Your Own Pollen guide and dashboard drawer item to “Connect User Wallets,” updated repository-owned #tag/byop links, and preserved the previous guide and fragment URLs through docs-route compatibility handling.
gist.impact: Developers now get a clearer label for connecting user wallets while existing BYOP bookmarks, links, and alternate terminology continue to work.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a friendly guide in a cozy documentation garden, carrying a tiny wallet toward a clearly labeled signpost reading “CONNECT USER WALLETS,” while an older “BYOP” trail marker remains visible as a well-kept side path. Small code-plants and a retro terminal represent preserved links and route compatibility.
